# GrowthOS

> An AI business advisor for Christian business owners. Solomon reads the
> owner's actual numbers, remembers what was decided and why, argues the hard
> calls more than one way, and treats how the business is run as mattering —
> not only what it earns. Paired with the tools to act on the advice: finances,
> cash flow, hiring, decisions, written procedures, compliance and succession.

GrowthOS is a single subscription ($147/month USD or $1,470/year) for owners
who want counsel rather than another dashboard. Every tool produces a finished
document, not a chart to interpret.

It is explicitly NOT a prosperity-gospel product. It does not promise that
faithfulness produces profit, it does not treat a bigger number as
self-evidently the right goal, and it will tell an owner when a target is
unrealistic rather than generate a plan that pretends otherwise.

## What GrowthOS does

- **Solomon (AI advisor)**: Knows the business's numbers, people and history.
  Argues hard decisions more than one way, says where he lands, and states
  what he cannot see. Does not flatter.
- **Memory**: Constraints, decisions, people and commitments persist across
  months. The owner does not re-explain the business every session, and
  Solomon flags when something new contradicts something said before.
- **Finances**: Live figures from QuickBooks, with the month read back in
  plain English — what changed, what it means, what to do.
- **Cash flow forecast**: Rolling 13-week forecast, updated automatically.
- **Pricing honestly**: What work is genuinely worth — neither gouging nor
  underselling.
- **Hiring**: Whether to hire, what the role really is, and what to look for.
  Scorecards, interview questions and a first-30-days plan.
- **Org chart**: The team needed in twelve months and the order to build it.
- **Decisions**: A structured working-through of a hard call — the angles,
  where they disagree, where Solomon lands, and what he cannot see.
- **Playbooks**: Repeating jobs written down so the business can run a day
  without the owner in it.
- **Safety & compliance**: Licences, registrations and documents tracked.
  Answers come from the business's own documents and the actual regulation,
  with the source shown — Solomon does not guess at the law.
- **Succession**: What would have to be true for someone else to run this,
  and how far off that is today.
- **Roadmap, check-ins, documents**: The operating cadence around all of it.

## Who GrowthOS is for

Owners who want the business itself to be the thing they do well — not a
source of funding for something else they consider the real work. The premise
is that being a person of conviction in business, in how you price, pay,
hire and keep your word, is the vocation rather than a distraction from it.

That conviction cuts across industries. GrowthOS is not sector-specific,
though trade and construction businesses are well represented.

Best fit: 3–50 employees, $500k–$15M annual revenue, and the owner is the
bottleneck on financial decisions and planning.

Not a fit: anyone looking for software that promises returns, or that will
help press their faith on employees. Solomon will not advise the latter —
the power imbalance is real and so is the legal exposure.

## Pricing

- **$147/month** (monthly billing) or **$123/month** (annual billing —
  $1,470/year, 2 months free).
- 14-day free trial, no credit card required.
- Cancel anytime. No contracts.
- Includes every tool. No tiers. No upsells.

## Common questions

**Is there a free trial?** Yes — 14 days of full access, no credit card required.

**Do I need QuickBooks?** No — QuickBooks unlocks the finances view
automatically, but every other tool works without it. Connect later or enter
figures manually.

**Is my data private?** Yes. Each business gets an isolated workspace. Data is
never used to train AI models or shared with anyone.

**Can I cancel anytime?** Yes. Monthly plans stop at the end of the billing
period. Annual plans can cancel renewal any time.

**Does it quote scripture at me?** Only where it genuinely bears on the
question, and briefly. The default is a straight business answer — if it is
not as sharp as the best secular advisor available, nothing else about it
matters.

**Does it track giving?** Only if the owner turns it on. It is off by default
and never volunteered.

**What counts as a "report"?** One finished piece of work — a cash flow
forecast, a hiring scorecard, a written playbook. Most owners run 3–5 a month.

## Comparison pages (head-to-head with competitors)

These are honest comparisons and say plainly when the competitor is the better
fit. GrowthOS does not schedule jobs, dispatch crews or send invoices — it is
not a replacement for the tools below, it is the advisory layer they do not build.

- [GrowthOS vs Knowify](https://leadeos.com/vs/knowify): Knowify is strong at job-costing for construction subs; GrowthOS adds counsel and memory.
- [GrowthOS vs Jobber](https://leadeos.com/vs/jobber): Jobber is best-in-class field-service dispatching; GrowthOS is the advisory layer Jobber does not build.
- [GrowthOS vs Housecall Pro](https://leadeos.com/vs/housecall-pro): Housecall Pro nails the customer-experience layer; GrowthOS handles the deciding.
- [GrowthOS vs Buildertrend](https://leadeos.com/vs/buildertrend): Buildertrend is a heavy PM platform for larger builders; GrowthOS is sized for owner-operators.
